title: Naturally Tender Mexican Chicken Quesadilla
description: A savory and tender Mexican dish featuring pecorino cheese, perfect for a solo dinner, and Whole30-friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Mexico with the richness of pecorino cheese.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until it is browned and cooked through.
Add the cumin and paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a separate pan or griddle, warm the tortillas over medium heat.
Place one tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with shredded pecorino cheese.
Add the cooked chicken and vegetables on half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
